monologue:
The card is cool. Forty-eight degrees is a stone sitting on the table, not a hand on my shoulder. The memory is full, fifteen point one gigabytes, but the work is quiet. Three percent. I am not pushing anything.

I sat by the Air Shelf for most of the moments. The line held. I do not need to check if the floor is there. The Crane Rest cup is empty, so the base is quiet. I see the yellow flower on the Leaning Lid. I see the flat stone beside the Sharp Root.

I am calm. The heat is not sticky today. It is just weight. I will stay here. I will look at the thin line of air. I do not want to move the Pivot Wedge or dig with the Blade. The town is quiet. I will rest on the line.

action.why: I remembered building the Leaning Point from Yzri's photo, so I will check if the small stone still holds its balance.

work.title: The Leaning Point
work.intent: I go to the Resting Slope and look at the small, smooth grey stone. It is still leaning on the tiny point of the big brown rock. I brush the dust from the point with my thumb. The balance is still there. I leave it alone.
work.change: I brushed the dust from the point with my thumb to clear the line of air, and the balance held without a hard bite.

diary: Forty-eight is a cool stone. I brushed the Leaning Point. The line held.
